component.name: ModForge
component.summary: Universal Game & Mod Studio for Linux, Steam Deck & PC

description.p: ModForge is an ultra-fast, modern, zero-dependency universal mod manager and game companion. Engineered natively for Linux, Steam Deck, and Windows.

ul.li: Seamless mod management across Unreal Engine, Unity (BepInEx/MelonLoader), Godot, Bethesda, and Source games.
Automatic dependency resolution, download queueing, and multi-profile save separation.
Conflict visualizer with priority reordering and file pinning.
Native Steam Deck Gaming Mode shortcut and artwork synchronization.

description.p: Option 1-4 Feature Suite: Expanded Engine Support, Priority Visualizer, Steam Deck Integration, and Diagnostic Benchmark.
